question: When does the within-region pixel residual improve low-label pixel-region classification?

scope_owners.A: fixed Q/A residual by fusion and capacity

development_bank.purpose: development only; does not inherit untouched status

confirmation.required_authority: Independent custodian publishes immutable geographic role, released labels and observation manifests. C does not inspect raw GT or sealed query.
prohibited: split a shared parent or known connected label component across confirm and fit
use unlabeled confirmation context for fit or routing calibration
confirmation.partition_unit: custodian-approved independent parent geography, not model seed or neighboring pixels
confirmation.geometry: No new coordinates are claimed released. Reuse existing geometry only for development. Custodian must assess independent components and class feasibility before confirmation assignment.
confirmation.buffer: Report measured observation-box separation, patch footprints, Q support and graph reach. Tile-local forwards eliminate direct cross-role paths; finite pixel gap alone does not establish geographical independence.
confirmation.classes: all declared original classes; unsupported class N/A with denominator, no silent removal
confirmation.models: A's frozen selected B0/Bcap/R configurations, no repeated development training by C
confirmation.split_and_support_seeds: custodian IDs separate from model seeds; freeze before opening confirm labels
confirmation.primary: scene-equal OA paired residual-minus-B0 and residual-minus-capacity
confirmation.benefit: both mean paired OA deltas >0, at least 2 of 3 paired model seeds positive, every guard passes; report all seeds/failures and block-level uncertainty; no significance claim from 3 seeds
confirmation.boundary: only frozen valid four-neighbor unlike labeled pairs; report 1/2/3-pixel bands and supported denominators, N/A when absent
confirmation.selection: first minimum development fused CE NLL; never confirmation labels; architecture, update budget and selection events fixed before release
confirmation.numerics: exact source/input/checkpoint identities; finite normalized outputs; preregister numerical policy separately. NUM-2 historical amendment is evidence, not automatic permission to relax a new gate.

external_engineering_pilot.executable_fallback: author DSNet pinned model, decomposed-feature comparator, not a superpixel graph or residual equivalent
external_engineering_pilot.comparison: direct author model versus input/output adapter, identical weights, patches, optimizer and events; this establishes adaptation equivalence only
external_engineering_pilot.patch: 7x7 tile-local replicated padding; no cross-role halo
external_engineering_pilot.budget: one deterministic traversal of every labeled training block per arm and seed; each released label seen once; freeze actual roster and step counts before execution
external_engineering_pilot.selection_events: 0, ceil(number_of_labeled_blocks/2), final; first minimum devval CE NLL
external_engineering_pilot.optimizer: Adam1e-4 shared recipe for both equivalence arms, no scheduler; disclose difference from upstream demo's two-rate Adam/StepLR/clipping
external_engineering_pilot.output: three original reconstruction/logit tensors; only classification logits scored, no invented graph/CNN heads
external_engineering_pilot.duration: CPU engineering planned <=5 minutes; real one-pass paired pilot planned 5-30 minutes, refine from zero-update measured cost before launch
external_engineering_pilot.gpu: inspect ownership first; GPU1/4 only if unclaimed. CPU is allowed. No memory/utilization cutoffs, no preemption.
